verdict.rationale: Aider operates entirely on local files and git repos, committing all AI edits as standard git commits (plain text, open format) rather than locking data in a proprietary store, and config is a plain YAML file — so there's little vendor lock-in by design. However, there is no explicit documentation of a data-export feature, chat/session history format, or any messaging about portability/'leaving' the product. Missing for 10: explicit chat/session export documentation, statement on session data formats, and any first-party 'no lock-in/data portability' claim.
